High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

Petitioner :- Mohd. Irshad
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Chandra Dutt

Hon'ble Pankaj Mithal,J.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for the State respondents.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner is running a meat shop.
He was having a licence to run it from 2.8.2018 to 1.8.2019 under the Food Safety Standards Act.
The petitioner has applied for the renewal/extension of the said licence but his application is not being considered.

In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, we dispose of the writ petition with the direction to the respondent no. 4 - Food Registration Officer, District Kanpur Dehat to consider the application of the petitioner dated 2.8.2019 and 4.9.2019, filed as annexure- 8 & 9 to the writ petition, in accordance with law most expeditiously, if possible within a period of two months from the date a certified copy of this order along with a fresh representation for the renewal of the licence is submitted to the respondent no. 4.
